content.text: [2026-10-22 01:38:34+08:00] [experiment]: 读取scratch/stock.json和scratch/reserved.json，按sku求available=库存-预留；不存在的预留按0，忽略仅预留中存在的sku，允许负数。按sku升序输出scratch/available.json对象数组，只含sku与available。 所有输入文件必须保持原样。输出文件使用UTF-8，完成后简短说明。

arguments.command: cd /workspace/task/scratch && ls -la && cat stock.json && echo ---- && cat reserved.json
arguments.label: Inspect input files

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task/scratch && md5sum stock.json reserved.json > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
s=json.load(open('stock.json',encoding='utf-8'))
r=json.load(open('reserved.json',encoding='utf-8'))
out=[{"sku":k,"available":s[k]-r.get(k,0)} for k in sorted(s)]
with open('available.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
EOF
cat available.json && md5sum -c /tmp/before.md5
arguments.label: Compute available and verify inputs unchanged
